results.ask: What's special about my block? I'm on 46th Ave between Moraga and Noriega.
results.expect: calls about_block; gives the block's own figures and something pinned nearby, with sources; cites
results.answer:
Your block sits about 39 feet above sea level and its homes were mostly built around 1941. The wider stretch has deep sand underfoot and the San Andreas Fault running 2 to 3 miles offshore.

Nearby:
- Freedom House and Rainbow House, Doelger's patriotic model homes from 1941–42, are about 950 feet east at 43rd Ave between Moraga and Noriega [Doelger Architecture](https://www.outsidelands.org/doelger-types.php), [SF Planning](https://default.sfplanning.org/Preservation/sunset_survey/Adopted_SunsetHCS.pdf).
- Old photographs are pinned at 46th & Moraga and 45th & Noriega [OpenSFHistory](https://opensfhistory.org).

Street cleaning:
- East side: Mondays 1st & 3rd, noon–2pm (next 11/16)
- West side: Thursdays 1st, 3rd, 5th, noon–2pm (next 11/19)
Signs on the block are the last word.

Who could tell you more about this stretch? A neighbor on 46th since 1974.
